source_evidence: Player exact 'Yes we can do more research tomorrow' follows Fenar suggesting supper as keeper closes at19:00. Treat affirmative as ordinary return to same Copper Hart inn and overnight, consistent with prior explicit choice to stay there and postpone research; usual2gp package for one night only, not a further discretionary commitment. Actual full Long Rest after previous5/6 and secure town night +2 units; only spent Cirren slot and Fenar Rage restore; no RNG, damage, further expenditure, or auto-selected morning research. D326~08:00 Copper Hart Inn, Orsaven. Player accepted supper and deferring more research until tomorrow, in response to Fenar at D325~19:00 map-room closing; interpret as returning to established inn for ordinary supper and overnight, under same prior 2gp package, not consequential new spending beyond that routine lodging. Party returns safely, pays2gp once for D325→326 two rooms, three non-V suppers and four horses' care/stabling; purse2051gp8sp6cp→2049gp8sp6cp. No extra fee, packed ration/feed deduction or unauthorized transaction invented. Uninterrupted secure night completes weighted Long Rest from5/6 (night supplies +2 sufficient to reach6), cycle reset0/6; no carry-over. Cirren second-level slots2→3/3; Fenar Rage3→4/4; all other HP/HD/resources already full. No new spell preparation or Fenar adaptation chosen. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 +1 Shield equipped, old shield retained, Boots of Elvenkind; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, breastplate and Insignia of Claws equipped; natural attacks+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging, mechanical greataxe unaffected. Mara, coach/four horses healthy. Rations21/feed28 as last established; paid lodging/care no duplicate debit. Routine D326 Tamsin contact under standing authorization, no specific estate changes asserted. Coris packet in map-room keeper outgoing custody addressed via Edric, actual dispatch/receipt and 300gp assessment pending; Mara retains authenticated copy; western crossing 48 road+12 rough miles (~3 days each way), expedition not chosen,800gp contingent. Diplomatic sealed invitation delivered D325; receipt and limited credentials retained, Crown response pending; separate frontier inquiry300+1300 contingent. Ferrymen's Share lead to shipwright obtained; Quenwood life sentence upheld, restitution ordered not paid, voluntary boatyard visit remains available. Both commissions deposits paid,520gp balance target353, Serpent Dart lead unresolved. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed; Kestrel custody and other relationships unchanged. D326 morning research or other activity V's choice; no specific visit, roll, reward, research result, new correspondence or quest accepted. V dice delegated until stop.
